title: Player colours: marker, glow and off-screen marker follow each player's pick (DPC 0.9.173-dev1, CD 2.9.19-dev1)
intro: You need: the Arisen and at least two pawns, out of combat on open ground. Keyboard and mouse plus two controllers (player 1 keyboard, players 2 and 3 on controllers). Weak goblins that can't die appear ahead, standing still. Each step lasts until you press End. Colours go back to the defaults at the end.

probes.cols: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; local t = {}; local nm = {}; for i, c in ipairs(D.R.ta_colors) do nm[i] = c[1] end; for n = 1, 4 do t[n] = 'P' .. n .. ' ' .. tostring(nm[D.R.player_color(n)]) end; return table.concat(t, ', ')
probes.file: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); if not (ok and d and d.colors) then return 'none' end; return string.format('p2 %08X p3 %08X', d.colors.p2 or 0, d.colors.p3 or 0)
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End.
1. START: Ctrl + F6, then each controller holds L3 + R3 to join (players 2 and 3). Each character should glow in the default colours: you amber, P2 light blue, P3 green. End when everyone is in.

2. PREVIEW: open the REFramework menu > Direct Pawn Control > co-op > Player colours. Press Preview for each player row, including P5 (red) and P6 (white). Note what colour each glow really looks like, especially White. End when done.

3. CHANGE P2: set Player 2 to Red. Player 2's glow should switch to red at once, their target dot (lock onto a goblin) red, and their off-screen marker red when they walk out of view. End when checked.
4. CHANGE P3: set Player 3 to White. Same checks: glow, target dot, off-screen marker. End when checked.
5. Colours back to the defaults (Gold, Cyan, Green, Magenta), goblins gone. End co-op when you like.
Done. Tell Claude how each colour looked, and whether White should be a different light.
